bullets.text: Thin Phone Revolution - **Motorola's** Edge 70 sets a new standard for slim devices with impressive battery life.
Disney Content Crisis - **Disney** pulls movies from **Google** platforms amid ongoing negotiations.
Windows 11 Audio Sharing - New feature allows simultaneous audio streaming to two Bluetooth devices.
Apple's Creative Competition - **Apple** invites UK iPad users to submit Christmas tree drawings for a public display.
iOS Freeform Upgrade - New **iOS 26.2** introduces table support in the Freeform app for enhanced productivity.
AirPods Translation Feature - **Apple** confirms Live Translation for AirPods will launch in the EU next month.
macOS Spotlight Enhancements - **macOS Tahoe 26.1** adds privacy tools for clipboard history in Spotlight.
iPadOS Productivity Boost - **iPadOS 26.1** reintroduces Slide Over for improved multitasking on iPad Pro.
Affordable 6K Display - **Asus** ProArt Display 6K offers exceptional value for Mac users at $1300.
Epic and Google Settlement - **Epic Games** and **Google** reach a settlement that may reshape Android's app ecosystem.
